```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ============================================================
# - Putative Functional Fusion Annotation
# - Keep recurrent fusions across samples, but remove repeated
#   same fusion calls within the same sample
# - exclude "-" 
# - split complex fusion entries separated by ";"
# ============================================================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Read SV data and build fusion table
# ============================================================

SV_df <- read.csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/SV_df_unqiue.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fusion_df <- SV_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(PutativeGeneFusion),
    PutativeGeneFusion != "",
    PutativeGeneFusion != "-"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    samples = sample,
    type    = Type,
    fusions = PutativeGeneFusion,
    chrA    = RefcontigID1,
    StartA  = RefStartPos,
    EndA    = RefStartPos,
    chrB    = RefcontigID2,
    StartB  = RefEndPos,
    EndB    = RefEndPos
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(fusions, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    fusions = trimws(fusions)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(fusions),
    fusions != "",
    fusions != "-",
    grepl(".+-.+", fusions)
  )
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Extract fusion partners
# ============================================================

fusion_df$geneA <- sapply(strsplit(fusion_df$fusions, split = "-", fixed = TRUE), function(x) x[1])
fusion_df$geneB <- sapply(strsplit(fusion_df$fusions, split = "-", fixed = TRUE), function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 2) paste(x[-1], collapse = "-") else NA
})

fusion_df$fusions_inv <- paste0(fusion_df$geneB, "-", fusion_df$geneA)

# ============================================================
#  Collapse repeated same fusion within the same sample
#    Keeps recurrence across different samples
# ============================================================

fusion_df <- fusion_df %>%
  distinct(samples, fusions, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# Basic summaries
# ============================================================

cat("Total SV rows in input:", nrow(SV_df), "\n")
cat("Total fusion rows after collapsing repeated same fusion within sample:", nrow(fusion_df), "\n")
cat("Unique fusion strings:", length(unique(fusion_df$fusions)), "\n")
cat("Unique samples with fusion calls:", length(unique(fusion_df$samples)), "\n\n")

cat("Fusion count per sample:\n")
print(table(fusion_df$samples))

cat("\nOriginal SV row count per sample:\n")
print(table(SV_df$sample))

cat("\nSamples present in SV_df but missing from fusion_df:\n")
print(setdiff(unique(SV_df$sample), unique(fusion_df$samples)))
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Read expression matrix
# ============================================================

expr_data <- read_tsv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/RNASeq/4_Count_file/tpm_matrix_log2TPM.txt",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

expr_data_clean <- expr_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene), Gene != "") %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Gene")
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Check overlap between fusion samples and expression samples
# ============================================================

fusion_samples <- unique(fusion_df$samples)
expr_samples   <- colnames(expr_data_clean)
common_samples <- intersect(fusion_samples, expr_samples)

cat("\nNumber of samples in fusion data:", length(fusion_samples), "\n")
cat("Number of samples in expression data:", length(expr_samples), "\n")
cat("Number of common samples:", length(common_samples), "\n")
cat("Common sample names:\n")
print(common_samples)
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Annotate expression values
# ============================================================

fusion_df <- fusion_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    geneA_exp = if (!is.na(geneA) &&
                    geneA %in% rownames(expr_data_clean) &&
                    samples %in% colnames(expr_data_clean)) {
      as.numeric(expr_data_clean[geneA, samples])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    geneB_exp = if (!is.na(geneB) &&
                    geneB %in% rownames(expr_data_clean) &&
                    samples %in% colnames(expr_data_clean)) {
      as.numeric(expr_data_clean[geneB, samples])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Function to classify expression status
# ============================================================

get_expr_status <- function(gene, sample, expr_matrix) {
  if (is.na(gene) ||
      !(gene %in% rownames(expr_matrix)) ||
      !(sample %in% colnames(expr_matrix))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  expr_vec <- expr_matrix[gene, ] %>% unlist() %>% as.numeric()
  expr_val <- as.numeric(expr_matrix[gene, sample])

  up_thresh   <- median(expr_vec, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.4 * sd(expr_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  down_thresh <- median(expr_vec, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.4 * sd(expr_vec, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (is.na(expr_val)) return(NA_character_)
  if (expr_val > up_thresh) return("up")
  if (expr_val < down_thresh) return("dn")
  return("normal")
}
```


```{r }
# ============================================================
# Annotate expression status
# ============================================================

fusion_df <- fusion_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    geneA_status = get_expr_status(geneA, samples, expr_data_clean),
    geneB_status = get_expr_status(geneB, samples, expr_data_clean)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r }
##### Combining expression status with functional annotation from OncoVar #####
oncoVar <- read.delim("/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Reference/ICGC.BRCA.all.genes.OncoVar.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(oncoVar) <- oncoVar$Gene_symbol

# Annotate Each Fusion Gene (A & B) with OncoVar Status
fusion_df$geneA_OncoTS <- ifelse(
  grepl("Oncogene", oncoVar[fusion_df$geneA, "OncoKB"], ignore.case = TRUE), "Oncogene",
  ifelse(grepl("TSG", oncoVar[fusion_df$geneA, "OncoKB"], ignore.case = TRUE), "TSG", NA)
)

fusion_df$geneB_OncoTS <- ifelse(
  grepl("Oncogene", oncoVar[fusion_df$geneB, "OncoKB"], ignore.case = TRUE), "Oncogene",
  ifelse(grepl("TSG", oncoVar[fusion_df$geneB, "OncoKB"], ignore.case = TRUE), "TSG", NA)
)

# Summarize Fusion Expression Status
fusion_df$exp <- ifelse(
  fusion_df$geneA_status == "up" | fusion_df$geneB_status == "up", "up-regulation",
  ifelse(fusion_df$geneA_status == "dn" | fusion_df$geneB_status == "dn", "down-regulation", "-")
)

write.csv(
  fusion_df,
  file = "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/fusion_expression_OncoVar_annotated.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Filter Expression-Relevant Fusions
functional_fusions <- fusion_df %>% 
  filter(exp != "-")
  
write.csv(
  functional_fusions,
  file = "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/functional_fusions_expression_only.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Shared Fusions Identified in Functional and Overlapping Datasets from DNA and RNA
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# Input files
# ============================================================
functional_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/functional_fusions_expression_only.csv"
overlap_file    <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/SVs/overlapping_fusions.csv"

# Output file
out_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/Functional_fusion_expression_OverlappingGene.csv"

# ============================================================
# Read files
# ============================================================
functional_df <- read_csv(functional_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
overlap_df    <- read_csv(overlap_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# Clean fusion names
# ============================================================
functional_df <- functional_df %>%
  mutate(fusions = trimws(fusions))

overlap_df <- overlap_df %>%
  mutate(OverlappingFusions = trimws(OverlappingFusions))

# ============================================================
# Keep only overlapping fusions
# ============================================================
overlap_functional_df <- functional_df %>%
  filter(fusions %in% overlap_df$OverlappingFusions)

# ============================================================
# Save output
# ============================================================
write_csv(overlap_functional_df, out_file)

# ============================================================
# Print summary
# ============================================================
cat("Total rows in functional fusion file:", nrow(functional_df), "\n")
cat("Total overlapping fusion names:", nrow(overlap_df), "\n")
cat("Matched rows saved:", nrow(overlap_functional_df), "\n")
cat("Output saved to:\n", out_file, "\n")
```
